Name: Francesca Trask
Description: Francesca Trask is the daughter of Bolivar Trask, though the relationship between Francesca and her father proved to be complicated as time past. Francesca began working at a hospital in New Apocalypse, and in her spare time acted as a member of the X-Terminated called Fiend. It was strongly hinted at that she may have had a past romance or one-night stand with her team-mate Horror Show.
